correctness.rationale: Each even adjacency trace is a sum of positive-part walk-range functions (n-R)+, convex in path length. The length-2n excursion gives strict discrete second difference at each n. Positive heat and inverse-binomial expansions preserve strict convexity, so elementary balancing and concentrating transfers classify unique gap-multiset extrema. The tridiagonal Green diagonal yields the exact inverse trace constants, with mu=0 limit. Supplementary exhaustive finite tests for N<=10 and mu in {0,0.5,2}, times 0.2,2.3, powers 0.5,1,2.25 pass 67056 assertions; analytical derivation proves all parameter ranges.
